PREMIERE316 STYLE-ONLY IMAGE REFERENCE CONTROL — V2
Asset ID: prop-hell-gate
Workflow profile: 2P39X1 (2.39:1)
Reference mode: ART DIRECTION ONLY — NO SUBJECT OR DESIGN TRANSFER.

The loaded images are non-content style plates. The asset prompt below is the sole authority for subject, identity, age, ethnicity, anatomy, wardrobe design, prop design, environment geometry, creatures, crowd population, pose, action, camera composition, wounds, blood placement, text, and all story content.

ALLOWED TRANSFER ONLY: overall palette; contrast curve; key/fill/rim relationship; volumetric-light behavior; atmosphere density; material highlight and shadow response; lens/exposure language; practical texture fidelity; cinematic depth; restrained film grain.

FORBIDDEN TRANSFER: faces or facial geometry; body identity or proportions; hairstyles; costume silhouettes; wounds or blood maps; weapons or props; architecture or set geography; creature designs; crowd layout; pose; framing; four-panel layout; lettering; logos; or any recognizable object from a reference, unless the asset prompt itself explicitly requests that exact element.

Prop/artifact guard: transfer only material response, patina, highlight rolloff, and photographic presentation. Do not add a glowing sword, sacred symbols, blood, or human hands unless this row explicitly requires them.

Active plate roles: warm-gold lighting and highlight rolloff; smoky umber shadow palette and ember atmosphere; abstract filmic tonal/material response and restrained grain.
When a reference conflicts with the row prompt, ignore the reference and obey the row prompt.

AUTHORITATIVE ASSET PROMPT
--------------------------
FUSED IRON-AND-BONE GATE — PRODUCTION REFERENCE: HERO PROP DESIGN, CONSTRUCTION, MATERIALS, SCALE, AND CONTINUITY.

Photorealistic live-action production reference, physically coherent lighting, exact anatomy, clean hands, consistent scale and materials, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, and no written or graphical elements.

Hero production reference of Hell's Gate from JESUS: THE HARROWING OF HELL — the colossal sealed double doors that bar the inner prison of the dead, shown intact in its pre-shattering fortress state as a complete physical object for set and VFX continuity. Scale is monumental: approximately one hundred feet tall and sixty feet wide, heavy enough that the viewer reads it as architecture rather than a normal door, yet framed so the entire gate assembly remains fully visible in frame as a production asset. Construction is a fused iron-and-bone composite: thick blackened iron plates and riveted straps interlock with dense pale and yellowed human bone — femurs, ribs, vertebrae, skull fragments — molten and forged into the metal until bone and iron share continuous surfaces and seams. The dual leaves meet at a central vertical join reinforced by massive corroded bronze hinges, straps, bosses, and locking hardware crusted with green-black patina, dried blood, and millennia of soot. Surface carvings cover nearly every panel: scenes of eternal torment and damnation frozen in metal, and especially a dense field of damned faces whose open mouths form silent millennia-long screams; each face is sculpted relief with hollow eyes, stretched jaws, and brow ridges catching raking light — not separate floating heads, but continuous bas-relief integrated into the iron-bone skin. Texture hierarchy is essential: pitted iron corrosion, blistered scale, oxidized rivet heads, polished high points where hands or weapons once scraped, matte bone with hairline cracks and marrow-dark cavities, rivulets of dark dried blood and viscous residue tracking downward like black tears, ash dust settled in carved recesses. The lower threshold and frame read as black obsidian-stone fortress architecture with iron reinforcements, scorched thresholds, and worn contact edges where the doors seal against the jamb. Continuity locks for all later states: materials always iron fused with bone; bronze fittings always corroded; faces always carved into the surface as permanent bas-relief (not modern text, logos, or readable inscriptions); intact sealed closed pose for this hero reference (cracking spiderweb fractures with inner fire, full shatter into molten fragments, and debris fields are separate continuity states, not shown here). Lighting for material read: cold blue torch key at roughly 2000K raking across relief from one side, deep crimson and red underglow from below at roughly 3500K catching under edges of carvings and bone ridges, soft volumetric smoke and suspended ash in the air, deep obsidian blacks and bruised shadow in recessed panels, subtle specular hits on surviving metal sheen — no pure darkness that hides construction, no modern studio softboxes, no divine golden flood yet (that arrives only when Christ shatters the gate). Camera and framing: cinematic prop-hero three-quarter frontal elevation, slightly low angle to convey overwhelming mass and height, 2.39:1 widescreen composition, medium-wide so both leaves, hinges, central join, threshold, and upper arch contact are complete; deep enough depth of field that carved faces, iron-bone fusion, and bronze fittings stay sharp; subtle atmospheric haze for scale without swallowing detail. Color grade matches hell fortress initial beat: deep crimsons (#8B0000), obsidian blacks (#0A0A0A), cold blue torch accents (#4169E1), red underglow, no warm golden divine key light. Sacred biblical epic tone — photoreal live-action production artifact, physically coherent materials, ancient dread and authority, not fantasy cartoon, not gore spectacle for its own sake, not game UI asset. No modern objects, no chains draped as the primary subject (those are separate props), no guardians or figures blocking the gate, no readable text, captions, watermarks, logos, borders, or typography of any kind. One continuous architectural double-door object: intact, sealed, fused iron and bone, carved damned faces, corroded bronze, dried blood, fortress scale.

Neutral production reference framing, the complete object visible, accurate materials and scale, no labels or text.
